The [[Adostic Arms/Legends|Adostic Arms]] '''8-gauge scatter gun''',<ref name="FC" /> also known as the '''8-gauge shotgun''',<ref name="CRO" /> was a large bore [[Shotgun/Legends|shotgun]] that fired small [[Steel/Legends|steel]] pellets. Based on primitive [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] technology, the 8-gauge scatter gun boasted stopping power equivalent to a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]]. It was constructed using modern materials and included an integrated recoil system to reduce the weapon's kick when fired.<ref name="FC" /> It had a maximum effective range of twenty-five [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="CRO" /> and cost between 500<ref name="GFT" /> and 550 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase. It was a favored by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[free-trader]]s because they could use the weapons within the tight confines of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] corridors and [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]] without risk of penetrating the hull.<ref name="FC" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operative [[Thar'quan]] carried an 8-gauge scatter gun.<ref name="CRO" />
